objects.description: [CanisterWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9042) has downloaded and executed binaries from dead drop URLs retrieved from ICP canister C2 nodes.(Citation: Aikido CanisterWorm MAR 2026)(Citation: Aikido TeamPCP Trivy MAR 2026) [CanisterWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9042) has also downloaded kubectl to compromised environments if it was not already installed.(Citation: Aikido CanisterWorm MAR 2026)
